- Pellow Home Living was renamed from Covey & Lark on 16 Feb. Treat "Pellow Home Living" as the current name and "Covey & Lark" as the old one.
- Moss's coverage digest says a saved report still reads "Covey — Late Arrivals". That title uses the old name and needs updating to match the rename.
- Ask June whether that saved report should be renamed, and whether any other saved reports or digests still use the old name.

I haven't sent anything to June. I tried to post these as a separate message in this channel, but the send failed, so this reply is where they are. If you want them posted as their own message, or sent to June as a DM, tell me and I'll try again.
